title.en: Spain and France brace for new heatwaves as wildfire closes in on Bordeaux
title.zh: 西班牙和法国为新一轮热浪做准备，野火逼近波尔多

summary.en: Spain and France are preparing for severe heatwaves, with temperatures expected to exceed 40C in some areas. These extreme conditions are intensifying ongoing wildfires, particularly near Bordeaux, and hindering efforts to control them.
summary.zh: 西班牙和法国正准备应对新一轮热浪，部分地区气温预计将超过40摄氏度。这些极端高温进一步阻碍了消防工作，尤其是在波尔多附近逼近的野火。

body.en:
Spain and France are bracing for new heatwaves with temperatures expected to soar past 40C in some regions.

Spain's national weather service says the severe weather is forecast to last until "at least" Sunday, and warns of "extreme" fire risks as firefighters continue to battle the some of the worst blazes in the country's history.

France's south-west regions Gironde and Landes are under "yellow alert" for a heatwave expected to peak on Wednesday, further hampering efforts to contain "very unpredictable" blazes in Gironde.

The mayor of Bordeaux has said he is preparing for "all eventualities", as one of the wildfires burning in France is 15km (nine miles) from the south-western city.

"We are preparing to accommodate a large number of people should further evacuations be ordered," said Thomas Cazenave.

Some 220,000 people have been evacuated in France and more than 100,000 in Spain, where fires are burning "uncontrolled" west of Madrid.

President Emmanuel Macron, visiting the fire-ravaged area in the Gironde region, said the country was facing a "completely unprecedented wildfire" - the "toughest since World War Two".

Macron said a smaller fire in the Landes region had been contained, but the fight continued in neighbouring Gironde.

While firefighters had made progress on Monday, Macron warned that "temperatures are set to rise again, the wind is still present, and therefore we must remain humble".

Earlier, Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez had said the fire "has a life of its own".

Jerome Steffe, the mayor of Cestas, a town south of Bordeaux, told the BBC this "will be the fire of the century".

He described how 17,000 residents were evacuated from his town during the night when the fire swelled two days ago. So far, he said, the region has seen 42,000 hectares (103,000 acres) of land burned and 240 houses destroyed.

And although the fire is no longer moving as quickly, he said his teams have "won only a small battle" and emphasised that the risk remains from flying embers or a sudden change in wind direction.

"We put all our energy into creating protective firebreaks," he explained, but admitted "we are all scared in front of this situation."

French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu warned the country "is going through an unprecedented fire season", with 116,085 hectares (286,852 acres) burned and 13,566 fire starts recorded since January.

The minister revealed in a post on X that nine out of 10 fires "are human-caused and most arise from carelessness: a cigarette butt, a barbecue, work carried out without precaution".

But he also said that not all these fires are accidents and some are deliberately set, adding that since 6 July, 162 arrests have taken place.

Wildfires are also burning in several other French regions, including Var and...
body.zh: 西班牙和法国正准备迎接新一轮热浪，部分地区气温预计将飙升至 40 摄氏度以上。 西班牙国家气象局表示，预计恶劣天气“至少”将持续到周日，并警告称，随着消防队员继续与该国历史上最严重的一些火灾作斗争，可能会出现“极端”火灾风险。 法国西南部地区吉伦特省和朗德省正处于热浪“黄色警报”，预计周三将达到顶峰，这进一步阻碍了遏制吉伦特省“非常不可预测”的大火的努力。 波尔多市长表示，他正在为“所有可能发生的情况”做好准备，因为法国境内燃烧的一场野火距离这座西南部城市 15 公里（九英里）。 托马斯·卡泽纳夫说：“如果下令进一步疏散，我们正在准备容纳大量人员。” 法国约有22万人被疏散，西班牙则有超过10万人被疏散，马德里以西的大火正在“失控”。 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在视察吉伦特省受火灾破坏的地区时表示，该国正面临一场“完全史无前例的野火”，这是“第二次世界大战以来最严重的一场野火”。 马克龙表示，朗德地区的小规模火灾已得到控制，但邻近的吉伦特省的战斗仍在继续。 尽管消防队员周一取得了进展，但马克龙警告说，“气温将再次上升，风仍然存在，因此我们必须保持谦虚”。 早些时候，内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，火灾“有自己的生命”。 波尔多以南小镇塞斯塔斯 (Cestas) 的市长杰罗姆·斯特夫 (Jerome Steffe) 告诉 BBC，这“将是世纪大火”。 他描述了两天前火势蔓延的夜间，17,000 名居民如何从他的城镇撤离。他说，到目前为止，该地区已有 42,000 公顷（103,000 英亩）土地被烧毁，240 栋房屋被毁。 尽管火势不再那么快蔓延，但他表示，他的团队“只赢得了一场小战斗”，并强调飞扬的余烬或风向突然改变的风险仍然存在。 “我们把所有的精力都投入到了防火隔离带上，”他解释道，但也承认“面对这种情况，我们都感到害怕。” 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努警告说，该国“正在经历前所未有的火灾季节”，自 1 月份以来已烧毁 116,085 公顷（286,852 英亩）土地，记录起火 13,566 起。 这位部长在 X 上的一篇帖子中透露，十分之九的火灾“都是人为引起的，大多数是由于疏忽造成的：烟头、烧烤、没有预防措施的工作”。 但他也表示，并非所有这些火灾都是意外，有些是故意纵火的，并补充说，自 7 月 6 日以来，已有 162 人被捕。 法国其他几个地区也发生野火，包括瓦尔和......

reflection.en: As heatwaves intensify and wildfires rage, we are reminded of creation's deep vulnerability and its longing for renewal. Yahweh's creation groans under the weight of present realities, calling us to both compassion for those affected and thoughtful stewardship of our shared world.
reflection.zh: 随着热浪加剧和野火肆虐，我们被提醒创造物深刻的脆弱性及其对更新的渴望。雅伟的创造物在当前现实的重压下叹息，呼吁我们对受影响的人们怀有怜悯，并深思熟虑地管理我们共同的世界。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

summary.en: Jacinta Allan has resigned as Victorian premier, with Ben Carroll taking over and immediately announcing a royal commission into the construction industry. Separately, donations made by Angus Taylor are being scrutinized by the Independent Commission Against Corruption (Icac).

body.en: Follow updates live Jacinta Allan resigns as Victorian premier before leadership challenge by Ben Carroll Who is Ben Carroll? Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast ACTU president says now is the ‘right time’ to leave Michele O’Neil, the president of the Australian Council of Trade Unions, said it’s the “right time” to leave after she announced her departure alongside ACTU secretary Sally McManus . We thought about this and we just think that it’s time for renewal. The union movement is in good shape. We’ve seen changes in workers’ rights that have made a big difference in workers’ lives. We’ve seen the union movement starting to grow for the first time in decades. And next year will be the 100th anniversary of the ACTU. So we think it’s time for a new leadership team to come in. We have a debt heading towards $200bn in this state. We have teachers out striking in the streets because the state government and Ben Carroll can’t secure a pay deal. We have holes in the roads. You need a majority government to fix those problems, and you need someone with a plan. Now he might performatively call a royal commission tokenistically, now that he’s become leader, but that’s not out of sincere concern about corruption. That’s out of sincere concern about the polls and what that means for Victorian Labor. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The news of leadership changes and investigations into donations and industry practices reminds us that Yahweh considers evil deeds by those in authority an abomination. True governance finds its stability and legitimacy in righteousness and integrity.
reflection.zh: 领导层变动以及对捐款和行业行为的调查提醒我们，雅伟视掌权者的邪恶行为为可憎。真正的治理在于公义和正直，以此建立其稳定性和合法性。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: ‘We have lost everything’: extreme rainfall across Asia brings flash floods and typhoons
title.zh: “我们失去了一切”：亚洲极端降雨引发山洪和台风

summary.en: Extreme rainfall across Asia has led to widespread flash floods and typhoons, causing immense devastation. From Afghanistan to Taiwan, an unprecedented deluge has highlighted the severe impact of climate breakdown, leaving many to lament the loss of their homes and livelihoods.
summary.zh: 亚洲各地遭遇极端降雨，引发大范围山洪和台风，造成巨大破坏。从阿富汗到台湾，前所未有的洪灾凸显了气候崩溃的严重影响，许多人哀叹家园和生计尽失。

body.en: From Afghanistan to Taiwan, unprecedented deluge highlights devastating impact of climate breakdown “It rained for 10 days and 10 nights, non-stop – I’d never seen anything like it,” says Anar Gul, a construction worker who lives in the remote district of Dur Baba in eastern Afghanistan. The houses in his village are built from stone and mud, which makes them extremely vulnerable to heavy rains. After days of rain, Gul’s kitchen collapsed and his neighbour, Sayed Afsar Sadat, saw a large part of his house completely destroyed. “Rains like this are coming heavier and earlier each year,” says Sadat. “They are destroying the roads and washing away our crops. It’s impacting us directly.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 从阿富汗到台湾，史无前例的洪水突显了气候崩溃的破坏性影响。居住在阿富汗东部杜巴巴偏远地区的建筑工人阿纳尔·古尔 (Anar Gul) 说：“这场雨持续了 10 天 10 夜，不间断，我从来没有见过这样的情况。”他村里的房子都是用石头和泥土建造的，这使得它们极易受到大雨的影响。经过几天的降雨，古尔的厨房倒塌了，他的邻居赛义德·阿夫萨·萨达特 (Sayed Afsar Sadat) 看到他的房子的很大一部分完全被毁。 “像这样的降雨每年都来得更大、更早，”萨达特说。 “他们毁坏了道路，冲走了我们的庄稼。这直接影响着我们。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The cries of those who have lost everything in Asia's extreme weather remind us of the profound suffering in our world. Yahweh promises a future where there will be no more death, mourning, crying, or pain, offering a deep hope for ultimate restoration amidst present devastation. This promise encourages us to care for those affected and to look forward to a...
reflection.zh: 亚洲极端天气中那些失去一切之人的哭声，提醒我们世上深重的苦难。雅伟应许一个不再有死亡、悲哀、哭号、疼痛的未来，在当前的浩劫中为我们提供了终极复原的深切盼望。这个应许鼓励我们关怀受灾者，并期待所有眼泪都被擦干的那一天。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: A dog saved Houssein Hamze from a bomb. When war returned, he stayed to care for Lebanon’s animals
title.zh: 一只狗救了侯赛因·哈姆泽一命。当战争再次爆发时，他选择留下照顾黎巴嫩的动物

summary.en: Houssein Hamze, founder of the Mashala shelter in Lebanon, was once saved by a dog's barking during a 2006 war. Now, amidst renewed conflict, he remains in the area, serving as the sole lifeline for stray animals abandoned or endangered by the ongoing crisis.
summary.zh: 黎巴嫩马沙拉动物收容所的创始人侯赛因·哈姆泽曾在2006年的一场战争中被一只狗的叫声救了一命。如今，在冲突再次爆发之际，他选择留在当地，成为那些因持续危机而被遗弃或处于危险中的流浪动物的唯一生命线。

body.en: In normal times the Mashala shelter founder takes in strays, but in wartime, he is the only lifeline for animals in the area During Israel’s 2006 war against Hezbollah, Houssein Hamze woke up one night to the sound of barking. Alarmed, he got up to check on the dog – his first rescue pet. Moments later, a bomb dropped next to his home and a piece of shrapnel landed right where he had been sleeping. “I swear to God, he really saved me from death. Animals always possess a sixth sense we don’t have,” Hamze said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 正常情况下，Mashala 收容所的创始人会收养流浪动物，但在战时，他是该地区动物的唯一生命线。2006 年以色列与真主党的战争期间，侯赛因·哈姆泽 (Houssein Hamze) 有一天晚上被狗叫声吵醒。他惊慌失措，起身查看这只狗——他的第一只救援宠物。过了一会儿，一枚炸弹落在他家附近，一块弹片落在他睡觉的地方。 “我向上帝发誓，他真的救了我一命。动物总是拥有我们所没有的第六感，”哈姆兹说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Houssein Hamze's dedication to Lebanon's animals, especially during wartime, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. His choice to stay and protect creatures who cannot speak for themselves embodies a profound compassion. Yahweh calls us to extend mercy and justice to all who are destitute, reflecting His own care for the least among...
reflection.zh: 侯赛因·哈姆泽在战时对黎巴嫩动物的奉献，提醒我们圣经中为弱者发声的呼召。他选择留下保护那些无法为自己说话的生灵，体现了一种深刻的怜悯。雅伟呼召我们向所有贫困无助者施予怜悯和公义，这反映了祂对我们中间最微小者的关怀。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Johnson & Johnson offers up to $5.5bn to settle US baby powder lawsuits
title.zh: 强生公司提出高达 55 亿美元和解美国婴儿爽身粉诉讼

summary.en: The proposed settlement aims to close a years-long legal battle over claims its talcs products cause cancer.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Johnson & Johnson (J&J) has offered to pay as much as $5.5bn (£4.14bn) to resolve tens of thousands of lawsuits in the US alleging that its baby powder and other products containing talcum cause ovarian cancer.

The proposed landmark settlement aims to close a long-running legal battle that has weighed on the New Jersey-based healthcare giant for years.

J&J has denied that its talc-based products caused cancer and has changed the formula of its widely used baby powder.

Erik Haas, the firm's vice president of litigation said on Monday , external that the allegations are "meritless" and that J&J was willing to settle in order to finally resolve the matter.

J&J said it will offer up to $3bn next year, with no additional payments due before 2028, it said.

The proposal must be accepted by legal firms representing 95% of the ovarian cancer claims in state and federal courts before it can be finalised, the J&J said.

Haas said in a statement that the company is confident that it would have "ultimately prevailed with further litigation" just as it has in the majority of cases heard in court to date.

He added that the proposed resolution "allows the company to put this matter behind it" and enable J&J to "remain focused on its mission to develop medicines and devices that save lives".

J&J's former consumer health business, Kenvue, holds liability for Johnson's baby powder outside North America.

Kenvue - which owns well-known brands including Band-Aid, Listerine, and Calpol - was spun off from J&J in 2022.

Earlier in July, a federal court handed the firm a victory by questioning individual plaintiffs' ability to show that talc was the direct cause of their ovarian cancer.

Talc is a natural mineral made of magnesium, silicon, oxygen and hydrogen, known for its soapy feel and is often used in baby powder.

The company has faced lawsuits from consumers and their survivors who claim J&J's talc products caused cancer due to contamination with asbestos.

Talc is mined from the earth and is found in seams close to that of asbestos, which is a material known to cause cancer.

J&J has repeatedly denied the allegations and in its latest announcement said: "Studies show talc is safe, does not contain asbestos and does not cause cancer."

In 2022, J&J said it would stop making and selling its talc-based baby powder around the world.

The announcement came more than two years after it had ended sales of the product in the US.

"As part of a worldwide portfolio assessment, we have made the commercial decision to transition to an all cornstarch-based baby powder portfolio," J&J said at the time.
body.zh: 强生公司 (J&J) 已提出支付高达 55 亿美元（41.4 亿英镑）的费用，以解决美国数以万计的诉讼，这些诉讼指控其婴儿爽身粉和其他含有滑石粉的产品会导致卵巢癌。 拟议的具有里程碑意义的和解协议旨在结束多年来困扰这家新泽西州医疗保健巨头的长期法律纠纷。 强生公司否认其滑石粉产品致癌，并改变了其广泛使用的婴儿爽身粉的配方。 该公司负责诉讼的副总裁埃里克·哈斯(Erik Haas)周一对外表示，这些指控“毫无根据”，强生愿意和解以最终解决此事。 强生表示，明年将提供高达 30 亿美元的资金，2028 年之前无需额外付款。 强生公司表示，该提案必须得到代表州和联邦法院 95% 卵巢癌索赔的律师事务所的接受，然后才能最终确定。 哈斯在一份声明中表示，该公司有信心“最终在进一步的诉讼中获胜”，就像迄今为止在法庭审理的大多数案件中一样。 他补充说，拟议的决议“允许公司将此事抛诸脑后”，并使强生公司能够“继续专注于开发拯救生命的药物和设备的使命”。 强生 (J&J) 的前消费者健康业务 Kenvue 负责北美以外地区强生婴儿爽身粉的销售。 Kenvue 于 2022 年从强生公司分拆出来，旗下拥有 Band-Aid、Listerine 和 Calpol 等知名品牌。 7 月初，一家联邦法院质疑个别原告是否有能力证明滑石粉是其卵巢癌的直接原因，从而使该公司取得了胜利。 滑石粉是一种由镁、硅、氧和氢组成的天然矿物质，以其肥皂感而闻名，常用于婴儿爽身粉中。 该公司面临着消费者及其幸存者的诉讼，他们声称强生的滑石粉产品因石棉污染而导致癌症。 滑石粉是从地球上开采出来的，在接近石棉的矿层中发现，而石棉是一种已知会致癌的材料。 强生公司一再否认这些指控，并在最新公告中表示：“研究表明滑石粉是安全的，不含石棉，也不会致癌。” 强生表示，2022 年将停止在全球生产和销售其滑石粉婴儿爽身粉。 该公告是在该产品停止在美国销售两年多后发布的。 强生公司当时表示：“作为全球产品组合评估的一部分，我们已做出商业决定，转向全以玉米淀粉为基础的婴儿爽身粉产品组合。”

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: US singer D4vd to go on trial for murder in death of 14-year-old
title.zh: 美国歌手D4vd将因谋杀青少年而受审

summary.en: A US singer is facing a murder trial after being accused of killing Celeste Rivas Hernandez, whose remains were discovered in a Tesla registered to his address.
summary.zh: 一名美国歌手将因涉嫌谋杀一名青少年而受审，受害者塞莱斯特·里瓦斯·埃尔南德斯的遗骸在其名下的一辆特斯拉汽车中被发现。

body.en:
A judge has ruled that US musician D4vd will go on trial for murder over the death of a teenage girl.

The decision came after a five-day preliminary hearing, in which Los Angeles prosecutors questioned a dozen witnesses and displayed photographic evidence as 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez's family watched on.

The star, whose legal name is David Anthony Burke, is accused of killing the girl, whose remains were found last September in a Tesla registered to his address.

Burke, 21, has pleaded not guilty to charges of murdering and sexually abusing her.

Burke's arraignment is scheduled for 31 August. The trial is to start within 90 days of that date.

Prosecutors have alleged Burke stabbed the teen before dismembering her body after years of alleged sexual abuse.

They allege he killed her because the teen had threatened to reveal his relationship with a minor and destroy his multi-million dollar music career.

Evidence read in court on Monday showed threats Hernandez made to Burke on 22 April 2025, stemming from arguments about his friendship with another girl.

"I swear to GOD I will kill u", one expletive-laden text said, followed by a threat to strangle him and tell her dad lies about him. "i will end ur career and ur life I will damage anything," the text went on.

The following day, Hernandez went to Burke's Hollywood home in an Uber he had sent to pick her up.

During questioning at the hearing on Monday, Detective Corey Farrell of the Los Angeles Police Department said text messages indicated that the defendant and the girl had attended church with her family.

In response to the defence, the detective said he was aware the teen had misrepresented her age to the defendant, telling him she was 16 and 18 at different times.

Burke's defence lawyers argued there was not sufficient evidence that he had committed the crime.

They said her parents were aware of what was going on between them and had even given written consent for her to travel to London with Burke for a week.

The defence highlighted texts on the 22nd and the 23rd of April that suggested Celeste had insisted on going to Burke's Hollywood Hills home and that he had argued against her coming before agreeing to send her an Uber on the night of the 23rd.

He "repeatedly expressed love and care for Ms Hernandez after they broke up", defence attorney Marilyn Bednarski said in court.

The medical examiner's inability to prove how the two penetrating wounds found in the girl occurred and the lack of surveillance video capturing Burke being home on the night of 23 April showed a lack of evidence, the defence argued.

Los Angeles County Superior Court Judge Charlaine Olmedo ruled that evidence presented during the preliminary hearing provided probable cause for a trial.

body.zh: 法官裁定美国音乐家 D4vd 因谋杀一名少女而受审。 这一决定是在为期五天的初步听证会后做出的，在听证会上，洛杉矶检察官询问了十几名证人，并在 14 岁的塞莱斯特·里瓦斯·埃尔南德斯 (Celeste Rivas Hernandez) 的家人旁观下展示了照片证据。 这位明星的法定姓名是大卫·安东尼·伯克，他被指控杀害了这名女孩，去年 9 月在登记在他地址的一辆特斯拉汽车中发现了女孩的遗体。 21 岁的伯克对谋杀和性虐待她的指控表示不认罪。 伯克定于 8 月 31 日受审。审判将于该日期后 90 天内开始。 检察官指控，伯克在多年遭受性虐待后，先刺伤了这名少女，然后肢解了她的尸体。 他们声称他杀了她，因为这名青少年威胁要揭露他与一名未成年人的关系，并毁掉他价值数百万美元的音乐事业。 周一在法庭上宣读的证据显示，塞莱斯特于 2025 年 4 月 22 日对伯克发出威胁，原因是他与另一名女孩的友谊发生争执。 一条充满咒骂的短信写道：“我向上帝发誓，我会杀了你。”随后威胁要勒死他，并告诉她父亲关于他的谎言。一条短信写道：“我会结束你的职业生涯和你的生活，我会破坏任何东西。” 第二天，埃尔南德斯乘坐伯克派来接她的优步前往伯克在好莱坞的家。

reflection.en: The tragic death of a young person and the subsequent murder trial remind us of the profound value Yahweh places on every life, especially the vulnerable. This solemn process underscores the gravity of actions that cause harm and the human longing for justice to prevail.
reflection.zh: 一名年轻生命的悲惨逝去以及随后的谋杀审判，提醒我们雅伟对每个生命，尤其是弱势生命，所赋予的深重价值。这一庄严的审判过程强调了造成伤害行为的严重性，以及人类对正义得以伸张的渴望。

title.en: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
title.zh: 多伦多美国领事馆今年第二次遭枪击

summary.en: Police in Toronto pursued a suspect after shots were fired at the US consulate, the second such incident this year. The suspect remains at large, though three people were arrested in connection with a similar attack in June.
summary.zh: 多伦多美国领事馆今年第二次遭到枪击，警方在高速追捕后未能逮捕嫌疑人，嫌疑人仍在逃。今年6月，另一起类似袭击事件导致三人被捕。

body.en:
Police in Toronto are investigating after a gunshot was fired at the US consulate in the city - the second time this year such an incident has happened.

Early on Monday morning, an officer stationed outside the consulate building heard the sound of a single gunshot and noticed a white car without a licence plate fleeing the scene.

Police briefly engaged in a high-speed car chase before ending it over safety concerns. No injuries were reported in the incident. It is unclear how many individuals were involved in the attack.

Monday's shooting comes after Toronto police arrested three people for a similar incident in March, which investigators have linked to a broader gun-for-hire network.

Toronto police said they were investigating the latest attack with the help of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) and international law enforcement partners.

Supt Jonathan Ko with the RCMP called it "another troubling incident", while the city's mayor, Olivia Chow, called the attack "brazen".

"I want to say to the person or persons responsible: We will get you," Chow added.

The shooting occurred around 04:45 local time (09:45 BST). Officers said they recovered one shell casing at the scene and damage to the building's facade.

At least two individuals were inside the consulate at the time, Toronto Police Deputy Chief Frank Barredo said, but he noted the building is "very heavily fortified" and those inside likely did not hear the gun shot.

He added that the investigation remains ongoing and that police across the city have been asked to lookout for the potential suspects.

In a post on X, the US consulate in Toronto thanked the police for their response.

Police have been stationed outside the consulate since March, when shots were fired outside the building in what police at the time called a "national security incident". No one was injured in that attack.

In June, police carried out raids in relation to the shooting. Police officer Marc Pinizzotto, 43, was killed during the operation.

Police later arrested several suspects aged 18 and 19 for allegedly carrying out a string of shootings, including the March attack outside the consulate, as part of a larger gun-for-hire network.

Two Jewish-owned bakeries in the city were also targeted, at least one by gunfire, over the weekend. Police said on Monday there was currently nothing to link the two incidents, but they did not rule out a connection.

"I'm totally disgusted by the shootings and vandalism that took place in Toronto over the last few days," Ontario Premier Doug Ford said.

Prime Minister Mark Carney, meanwhile, said he was "appalled" and added: "Law enforcement has my full support as they conduct a thorough investigation and hold those responsible to account."

body.zh: 多伦多警方正在调查美国驻多伦多领事馆发生枪击事件，这是今年第二次发生此类事件。 周一清晨，一名驻扎在领事馆大楼外的官员听到一声枪响，并注意到一辆没有牌照的白色汽车逃离现场。 警方短暂进行了一场高速汽车追逐，然后出于安全考虑而结束。事件中没有人员受伤的报告。目前尚不清楚有多少人参与了此次袭击。 周一的枪击事件发生之前，多伦多警方在三月份因类似事件逮捕了三人，调查人员将这起事件与更广泛的枪支雇佣网络联系起来。 多伦多警方表示，他们正在加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）和国际执法合作伙伴的帮助下调查最新的袭击事件。 加拿大皇家骑警警官乔纳森·科 (Jonathan Ko) 称这是“另一起令人不安的事件”，而该市市长周奥利维亚 (Olivia Chow) 则称这次袭击是“无耻的”。 “我想对责任人说：我们会抓到你的，”周补充道。 枪击事件发生在当地时间 04:45 左右（英国夏令时间 09:45）。警方表示，他们在现场发现了一枚弹壳，并发现了建筑物外墙的损坏情况。 多伦多警察局副局长弗兰克·巴雷多说，当时领事馆内至少有两人，但他指出，该建筑“戒备森严”，里面的人可能没有听到枪声。 他补充说，调查仍在进行中，全市警方已被要求寻找潜在的嫌疑人。 美国驻多伦多领事馆在 X 上发帖感谢警方的回应。 自三月份以来，警察一直驻扎在领事馆外，当时领事馆外有人开枪，警方当时称这是一起“国家安全事件”。在那次袭击中没有人受伤。 六月，警方针对枪击事件进行了突击搜查。 43 岁的警官马克·皮尼佐托 (Marc Pinizzotto) 在行动中身亡。 警方随后逮捕了几名 18 岁和 19 岁的嫌疑人，他们涉嫌实施一系列枪击事件，其中包括 3 月份领事馆外的袭击事件，这是一个更大的枪支雇佣网络的一部分。 周末，该市两家犹太人开的面包店也成为袭击目标，至少其中一家遭到枪击。警方周一表示，目前没有任何证据表明这两起事件有任何联系，但他们并不排除两者之间存在联系。 安大略省省长道格·福特表示：“我对过去几天在多伦多发生的枪击和破坏行为感到非常厌恶。” 与此同时，英国首相马克·卡尼表示，他感到“震惊”，并补充道：“我全力支持执法部门进行彻底调查，并追究责任人的责任。” 5月，美国官员逮捕了...

reflection.en: Attacks on diplomatic missions challenge the peace and order that governing authorities are called to uphold. This incident reminds us of the ongoing need for vigilance and the difficult task of maintaining security and justice in a complex world. We pray for wisdom for leaders and for the safety of all.
reflection.zh: 针对外交机构的袭击挑战了执政当局被呼召维护的和平与秩序。这起事件提醒我们，在一个复杂的世界中，持续的警惕以及维护安全和正义的艰巨任务是多么重要。我们为领导者祈求智慧，也为所有人的安全祈祷。

verse.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established.
verse.textZh: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。

title.en: What to expect from Zelensky and Netanyahu's visit to Washington
title.zh: 泽连斯基和内塔尼亚胡的华盛顿之行有何期待

summary.en: Republican Senator Lindsay Graham's funeral is bringing the two world leaders to town, where they'll separately visit the White House to discuss their region's wars.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Tuesday is a big day in Washington DC, even by White House standards. Long-time Republican Senator Lindsay Graham's funeral is bringing the Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to town. They will separately meet with President Donald Trump at the White House to discuss two different wars: the war in Ukraine and the war in Iran.

The BBC's North America editor Sarah Smith previews the visit and explains the late senator's remarkable influence on the two conflicts.
body.zh: 即使按照白宫的标准，周二也是华盛顿特区的重要一天。长期担任共和党参议员的林赛·格雷厄姆的葬礼将由乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基和以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡前往城里举行。他们将分别在白宫与唐纳德·特朗普总统会面，讨论两场不同的战争：乌克兰战争和伊朗战争。 BBC 北美编辑莎拉·史密斯预告了这次访问，并解释了已故参议员对这两场冲突的显着影响。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Trump tries optimism as foes hold fire and Iran denies peace talks
title.zh: 敌人开火、伊朗否认和谈，特朗普试图保持乐观

summary.en: Fighting between the US and Iran has been paused since the weekend. While Trump expressed hope for a deal, Iran has remained unmoved.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump has voiced optimism at the prospect of a negotiated peace deal with Iran, as the two sides held their fire for a third consecutive day.

Fighting between the longtime foes has been paused since Saturday after 13 nights of renewed US strikes on the Islamic republic sparked by a breakdown in diplomacy over Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

But the US leader expressed hope on Tuesday that renewed diplomacy could bring an end to the war that began in late February with a wave of US-Israeli strikes, rattling both the region and the global economy.

"I have a lot of patience ... We'll see what happens," he said aboard Air Force One.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Iran had earlier denied that there were any direct talks with the US to end the conflict.

"Mediators may convey messages from the American side to us regarding current developments in the region. But at present, we are not engaged in any negotiations with the United States," said Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei.

Trump told the US news outlet Axios that mediating countries had asked him to hold fire to give diplomacy a chance, adding: "We are in very deep talks with Iran."

Aboard Air Force One, he said that if the new efforts failed, "we go back to doing what we were doing" before the pause in fighting.

On that subject, he dismissed concerns that US ammunition stockpiles were running low nearly five months after war broke out.

"We have a lot of ammunition. We have a lot of the mid-level stuff too, more than we could ever use no matter what," he said.

Despite the recent lull, Saudi Arabia came under attack on Monday, with its defence ministry saying it had intercepted several drones fired by Iran-linked groups in Iraq targeting oil facilities.

No group claimed responsibility, but the Saudis called on Baghdad to prevent such attacks from being launched from its territory.

Pakistan, which has been mediating a resolution to the Middle East war, condemned the drone attacks, saying they "pose a grave threat to peace and stability" in the region.

Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels also said they launched drone attacks on Saudi Arabian oil infrastructure in response to incursions by the kingdom's drones. Saudi Arabia is yet to comment on the claim.

title.en: 'Big mistake' Australian travellers warned not to make as wildfires burn across Europe

summary.en: Wildfires are causing significant disruption across Europe during its peak holiday season, prompting Australian travelers to seek updated information and review their travel insurance policies.

As hundreds of thousands of people flee fast-moving wildfires across Europe, Australians heading overseas are being urged to stay informed, monitor official travel advice and understand what their travel insurance covers if their plans change.

More than 330,000 people have been evacuated across France and Spain as fires burn through popular holiday destinations, closing roads, delaying flights and forcing communities to flee. Authorities have also issued fresh evacuation orders near the historic Spanish city of Toledo, while firefighters continue battling major blazes around Bordeaux in southwestern France.

The fires have intensified during Europe's busy summer holiday period, with airports, major roads and tourist destinations among those affected as emergency services race to contain the blazes.

In France, more than 220,000 people have been evacuated as wildfires continue to burn through the Gironde region, home to vineyards, coastal towns and the popular tourist destination of Cap Ferret.

French interior minister Laurent Nuñez described the situation as "very unfavourable", warning the fire was moving towards Bordeaux, although authorities have so far ruled out evacuating the city itself.

The blaze came within about 15km of Bordeaux's outskirts over the weekend, prompting police to go door-to-door in nearby communities to evacuate residents.

Travel has also been disrupted, with Bordeaux Airport reporting widespread delays after air traffic restrictions were introduced to allow firefighting aircraft to operate safely.

Spain is also grappling with multiple major blazes, with more than 115,000 people evacuated and another 30,000 ordered to shelter in place.

The largest fire, in the central province of Ávila, has burned more than 50,000 hectares, making it the country's biggest wildfire in recent history. Fires continue to burn near Madrid and in the eastern province of Castellón.

Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has announced a civil protection emergency will be declared in the affected central regions, unlocking additional recovery funding.

More than 150,000 hectares have burned across Spain since the start of the year — six times the area destroyed over the same period last year.

Australian travellers are being urged not to panic, but to closely monitor conditions, remain flexible and understand what their travel insurance does — and doesn't — cover if their plans are disrupted.

Walking from Jantar Mantar to Connaught Place in central New Delhi on Saturday evening provided an unusual sight for the prime corridor of power in the world's largest democracy.

Satirical posters mocking India's legislative, executive and judiciary were plastered on the walls, and the pavement was sprayed with sometimes "vulgar" graffiti mocking Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

These were all remnants of thousands of young Cockroach movement protesters who had flooded the streets hours earlier after India's Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned .

Celebrating Pradhan's resignation, which had been a core protest demand , some protesters were heard telling security officials "see you at the next protest," coming only days after several people were injured in clashes with baton-wielding police who fired tear gas into crowds.

Instagram was also full of images from cities across India with young people dancing in front of police officials to the line "Everybody knows that I'm a good girl, officer " from Lana Del Ray's song "Playing Dangerous."

Others held posters reading: "Cuff me, daddy" and some were seen climbing atop police barricades.

The movement, known as the Cockroach Janta Party movement (CJP) , came after the chief justice of India referred to unemployed young people as "cockroaches" in an offhand remark. The name is also a play on Narendra Modi's Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

Since a scandal broke in May involving a highly competitive university entrance exam, the Gen Z protests have spread across India, challenging the political establishment with Instagram reels, viral trends, sarcastic jingles and posters.

"In our generation humor has become the defense mechanism from pain, frustration and helplessness. This entire protest is driven by humor, driven by Instagram and social media," Karan Azad, a 24-year-old law student, told DW at the Jantar Mantar protest site in New Delhi.

Another protester held a sign addressed to Modi reading in transliterated Hindi: "Buddy, you can't even make tea," alluding to Modi's boyhood days as a tea seller.

title.en: Ghana's community service bill: A fix for the prison crisis?
title.zh: 加纳的社区服务法案：解决监狱危机的方法？

summary.en: The community service bill offers community service as an alternative to prison sentences, particularly for minor offenses. It's meant to decongest Ghana's prisons and prevent overcrowding once it's signed into law.
summary.zh: 这项社区服务法案为轻微罪行提供了社区服务作为监禁的替代方案。一旦签署成为法律，它旨在缓解加纳监狱的拥挤状况，防止过度超员。

body.en:
The community service bill offers community service as an alternative to prison sentences, particularly for minor offenses. It's meant to decongest Ghana's prisons and prevent overcrowding once it's signed into law.

Ghana's parliament recently passed the Community Service Bill , 2026. The piece of legislation is designed to introduce community service as an alternative to custodial sentences for minor offenses. The bill also seeks to ease pressure on the country's overcrowded prisons and reshape how justice is administered for minor crimes .

The legislation establishes a National Community Service Secretariat and provides a legal framework for courts to impose community service in Ghana instead of imprisonment for specified offenses.

According to the government, the move will reduce the financial strain of maintaining prison facilities, which have long suffered from inadequate budgets, high medical costs and chronic congestion .

"If you check the current prison population, overcrowding is over 37%. We have a current population of over 13,000 prisoners. Today the cost of maintaining them, feeding them alone, requires 10 million cedis (€752,000, $859,000)  a quarter," Ghana's Interior Minister, Muntaka Mubarak, who tabled the bill in parliament , told the house during a debate.

Under the bill, community service applies to offenses punishable by not more than three years' imprisonment, with or without a fine. Courts may also impose community service for offenses that carry fines alone or fines combined with imprisonment.

This means petty crimes such as false publication or traffic offenses could now attract noncustodial penalties.

Legal practitioner Christian Malm Hesse described the bill as "a step in the right direction," noting its potential to reduce prison overcrowding .

He told DW that the bill provides a structured alternative for misdemeanor offenses that previously defaulted to custodial sentences.

However, some Ghanaians believe that its effectiveness will depend on proper categorization of offenses and public education.

According to DW correspondent Eric Mawuena Egbeta, many Ghanaians still need clarity on which offenses qualify.

"An offense which is higher than a misdemeanor would mean that you will not get a community sentence… A lot more persons would need education on it," Egbeta said.

body.zh: 社区服务法案提供社区服务作为监禁刑罚的替代方案，特别是对于轻微犯罪。一旦签署成为法律，其目的是缓解加纳监狱的拥挤状况并防止过度拥挤。 加纳议会最近通过了《2026 年社区服务法案》。该法案旨在引入社区服务，作为轻罪监禁刑罚的替代方案。该法案还旨在缓解该国过度拥挤的监狱的压力，并重塑对轻微犯罪的司法管理方式。 该立法设立了国家社区服务秘书处，并为法院在加纳实行社区服务而不是对特定罪行进行监禁提供了法律框架。 政府表示，此举将减轻维护监狱设施的财政压力，监狱设施长期以来一直遭受预算不足、医疗费用高昂和长期拥堵的困扰。 加纳内政部长蒙塔卡·穆巴拉克在议会辩论中向议会提交了该法案，他表示：“如果你检查一下目前的监狱人口，就会发现监狱过度拥挤的程度超过 37%。我们目前有超过 13,000 名囚犯。如今，维持这些囚犯的费用，仅是喂养他们，就需要四分之一的 1,000 万塞地（752,000 欧元，859,000 美元）。” 根据该法案，社区服务适用于可判处三年以下监禁、并处或不处罚款的犯罪行为。法院还可以对单独罚款或罚款与监禁相结合的犯罪行为实行社区服务。 这意味着虚假发布或交通违法等轻微犯罪现在可能会受到非监禁处罚。 法律从业者克里斯蒂安·马尔姆·黑塞 (Christian Malm Hesse) 将该法案描述为“朝着正确方向迈出的一步”，并指出其有可能减少监狱过度拥挤。 他告诉德国之声，该法案为以前默认判处监禁的轻罪提供了一个结构化的替代方案。 然而，一些加纳人认为，其有效性将取决于对犯罪行为的适当分类和公共教育。 德国之声记者 Eric Mawuena Egbeta 表示，许多加纳人仍然需要明确哪些罪行符合资格。 埃格贝塔说：“比轻罪更严重的罪行意味着你不会被判社区刑……更多的人需要这方面的教育。” 对于像黑塞这样的法律从业者来说，该法案的一项关键保障是要求提供社会调查报告，这有助于法官评估罪犯的背景、情况和社区服务的适合性。黑塞表示，此类措施可确保量刑决定的知情性和一致性，从而降低任意判决的风险……

summary.en: Peru's new president, Keiko Fujimori, has promised more security and investment. As she takes office, she'll have to find space for the South American nation amid Washington and Beijing's geopolitical rivalry.

body.en:
Peru's new president, Keiko Fujimori, has promised more security and investment. As she takes office, she'll have to find space for the South American nation amid Washington and Beijing's geopolitical rivalry.

When Keiko Fujimori steps into the presidential office on Tuesday, she'll bring back a political movement that hasn't been in power for more than a quarter century.

Fujimorism, a mix of neoliberalism, populism and strict government policies, characterized the 1990-2000 presidency of her father, the late Alberto Fujimori. Keiko Fujimori is stepping in amid a climate of social polarization, with promises to deliver more security, economic recovery and improvements in the health and education sectors.

But beyond those domestic projects, Fujimori is taking charge at a time of increased strategic importance for Peru . The country has become one of the key battlegrounds in the growing competition between the United States and China for political influence in South America.

Fujimori has already signaled that security will be the top priority for her government.

On the agenda: more video surveillance, a stronger police presence, tougher punishment for crimes and organized gangs, and command and control centers across the country. Part of the crackdown includes the construction of four mega-prisons, like those in El Salvador .

Eliana Carlin, a political science expert at the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru in Lima, is concerned by how Fujimori's plans will affect human rights .

"Behind [these measures] lie strong ideological positions intended to justify making the police and the armed forces solely subject to military jurisdiction," she said.

In addition to a stronger focus on security, Fujimori has said she intends to advance infrastructure projects, attract private investment, build new schools and hospitals and modernize the country with the help of technology and artificial intelligence .

But delivering on these pledges depends largely on whether the government can find the necessary funds. Infrastructure and essential services continue to face significant deficits. Added to that is the surging crime rate and the threat of the strengthening El Nino weather pattern , which could hit Peru with increased drought, extreme heat , flooding and other climate-related disruptions.

Foreign policy will also be a major challenge for Fujimori's administration. The opening of the Chancay port and logistics hub has turned Peru into a strategic player in regional trade — and made it a central focus in the geopolitical rivalry between Washington and Beijing.

Iran says it is still in control of the Strait of Hormuz and not ‌seeking to resume peace talks with the United States.

Following 13 successive nights of intensifying bombing that provoked Iran to fire ‌on US bases in response, Trump halted the campaign over the weekend.

Iran said it would pause its own attacks for as long as the US pause in bombing endures.

Trump's decision to suspend the campaign reflected advice from his top brass ‌that the bombing, aimed at breaking Iran's grip on the strait, had reached the limits of what it could achieve, according to a US official and widespread US media reports.

The US official told Reuters that military commanders had advised the president they were running out of targets.

The official said the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, General Dan Caine, had also expressed concern over the depletion of air defence weapons used to protect US bases in the region.

Similar reports indicating that civilian and military aides had advised Trump to halt the campaign were carried over the weekend by the New York Times, CNN, Axios and other news outlets.

The US ambassador to the United Nations, Mike Waltz, said on ‌Sunday Trump had paused ‌the campaign to allow room for negotiations.

But ⁠the spokesperson for Iran's Foreign Ministry, Esmail Baghaei, said in a televised press conference on Monday that Iran had not asked to resume peace talks with the United States.

The end of the US bombing campaign sent oil prices tumbling in the hope that disrupted global supplies could resume flowing.

Brent crude, which had briefly ticked above AU$150 a barrel last week for the first time since May, fell around 7.8 per cent by mid-morning on Monday to just under AU$130.

But in a clear bid to signal that the US bombing had failed in its objective, Tehran indicated it was still in control of the world's most important waterway for energy markets.

Several Iranian state media outlets carried the same report, citing an "informed source" as saying that Iran had turned around six "offending ships" on Monday morning that had attempted to cross the strait without ⁠its permission.

"As previously announced, the traffic route in the Strait ‌of Hormuz is the route specified by Iran, and other routes are contaminated and have no way out," the Iranian state media reports quoted the source as saying.

Trump launched his renewed bombing campaign to punish Iran after Tehran fired on ships using a route through the strait that ‌has been promoted by the United States, which has told vessels to sail close to the coast of Oman.

body.en:
Two mosques in the Israeli-occupied West Bank were set on fire overnight in an apparent Israeli settler attack, officials said overnight, after a spate of deadly violence that killed four Palestinians and two Israeli soldiers.

Palestinians and the Israeli opposition accuse Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's hard-line government of turning a blind eye to attacks by settlers against Palestinians , which threaten to ignite widespread violence across the territory.

Israeli soldiers and police fanned out across the West Bank after the attack, closing off major roads and blocking access to a hospital. Israel also arrested more than 70 Palestinians over the weekend.

The mosques, in the villages of Qusra and Kour in the northern West Bank, suffered extensive damage in the fires.

In Qusra, the attackers spray-painted "revenge Benayahu," referring to one of the settlers killed on Friday, and "the land of Israel is redeemed with blood".

Ahmed Abu Mahmoud, 64, who lives next to the Qusra mosque, said he heard noises at 3am and discovered the mosque had been set on fire. The fire was too large for him to fight on his own, so he called for help.

"The military arrived here, saw with their own eyes and then left," Mahmoud said.

He added that the attackers spray-painted Hebrew graffiti on the mosque's walls, including the word "revenge".

Security footage in Kour obtained by The Associated Press showed three people dressed in civilian clothes setting off a large explosion in the entrance of the mosque in the middle of the night.

In a separate incident, Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque in the village of Kour, near Tulkarem, and spray-painted racist slogans on its walls, according to the Palestinian ministry of religious affairs.

The ministry said that "groups of settlers burned a mosque in the village of Kour in Tulkarem governorate and wrote racist slogans on its walls".

Israel's military said it was working with police to investigate the mosque attack.

"The security forces strongly condemn incidents of this kind, including harm to religious sites, and will continue to act decisively to maintain security and public order in the area," it said.

The Israeli army often announces investigations into violence against Palestinians but rarely makes arrests or prosecutes settlers involved in violence.

The exact circumstances of Friday's deadly incidents remained unclear, but Israeli media reports and interviews with local Palestinian officials said they were sparked after a group of armed settlers entered the village of Tell and were resisted by residents who were fearful of an attack.

After days of rain, Gul’s kitchen collapsed and his neighbour, Sayed Afsar Sadat, saw a large part of his house completely destroyed. “Rains like this are coming heavier and earlier each year,” says Sadat. “They are destroying the roads and washing away our crops. It’s impacting us directly.” Continue reading...

title.en: China's new challenge as natural disasters strike - fake AI videos
title.zh: 自然灾害来袭，中国面临的新挑战——假人工智能视频

summary.en: Storms and flooding incidents over the last few months have seen fake videos inundating social media.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As China deals with the fallout of Typhoon Noul that made landfall over the weekend, officials will be painfully aware that they will likely have an additional challenge to deal with: dangerously misleading videos created with Artificial Intelligence (AI).

Powerful storms and flooding incidents over the last few months have seen fake videos inundating social media platforms – these include images of dead bodies floating in floodwaters, the false depiction of severe flooding in areas actually not affected and others with blatantly fake details of emergency response efforts.

In some areas, videos containing false information about power outages prompted residents to panic buy emergency supplies.

Flooding in Hengzhou city, Guangxi in early July caused hundreds of snakes to escape from a breeding farm. Then fake images were also published showing crocodiles being released into a river.

In an already tense and dangerous situation involving mass evacuations and complex rescue operations, authorities want to avoid panic. Now they fear that AI technology - which China is pouring billions of dollars into - is providing simple, accessible tools that can be used to trick the public.

"Many of these content creators use disaster news to try to gain followers, knowing that more sensational or exaggerated content will garner more likes and more views. They are deliberately fabricating information to grab people's attention," Huang Zhihua, Deputy Chief in charge of online public security for Zhejiang Police Department told Chinese state media.

In recent weeks, there have been arrests and punishment – ranging from detention awaiting criminal prosecution to fines – for the creation of bogus reports and video content.

But experts are warning that an unprecedented crisis of misinformation could be looming.

In an article published by the newspaper of the Communist Party's Central Party School, Professor Chen Bin said, "AI dramatically lowers the technical barriers to producing false information. Individuals no longer require sophisticated technical skills. By simply prompting AI tools, they can rapidly generate convincing text, images, audio and video… which is highly realistic but entirely fabricated content, manufactured on a large scale."

Professor Gao Fuping, from the East China University of Political Science and Law, told the BBC that motivation for the publishing of such false content ranges from those who do it "to create something amusing without thinking about the consequences", to those who want to "generate traffic for personal gain" or those who wish to deliberately "cause panic or social unrest".

"Some users think the online world is anonymous and unregulated or that they cannot be traced," he said.

body.zh: 当中国应对周末登陆的台风诺尔的影响时，官员们将痛苦地意识到他们可能还要应对额外的挑战：用人工智能（AI）制作的危险的误导性视频。 过去几个月发生的强烈风暴和洪水事件导致社交媒体平台上充斥着虚假视频——其中包括漂浮在洪水中的尸体的图像、对实际未受影响地区严重洪水的虚假描述，以及其他公然虚假的应急响应工作细节。 在一些地区，包含有关停电的虚假信息的视频促使居民恐慌购买应急物资。 7月初，广西衡州市发生洪水，导致数百条蛇从养殖场逃出。随后还发布了一些假图片，显示鳄鱼被释放到河里。 在涉及大规模疏散和复杂救援行动的紧张和危险局势中，当局希望避免恐慌。现在，他们担心中国正在投入数十亿美元的人工智能技术正在提供简单、易于使用的工具，可用于欺骗公众。 浙江省公安厅网络公安分管副局长黄志华对中国官方媒体表示，“许多内容创作者利用灾难新闻来吸引关注者，因为他们知道更耸人听闻或夸张的内容会获得更多点赞和浏览量。他们故意捏造信息来吸引人们的注意力。” 最近几周，有人因制作虚假报告和视频内容而遭到逮捕和处罚，从等待刑事起诉的拘留到罚款。 但专家警告说，一场前所未有的错误信息危机可能即将来临。 陈斌教授在中共中央党校报刊发表的文章中表示，“人工智能极大地降低了制造虚假信息的技术门槛，个人不再需要高深的技术技能，只需人工智能工具的提示，就可以快速生成令人信服的文字、图像、音频和视频……这些内容高度真实，但完全是捏造的、大规模制造的内容。” 华东政法大学教授高福平告诉BBC，发布此类虚假内容的动机包括“为了制造一些有趣的事情而不考虑后果”，到“为个人利益产生流量”或故意“引起恐慌或社会动荡”。 “一些用户认为网络世界是匿名的、不受监管的，或者他们无法被追踪，”他说。 有人呼吁所有人工智能生成的......

summary.en: Four decades after Wham! became the first Western pop act to tour China, Andrew Ridgeley reflected on the surreal experience, including silent gigs and awkward embassy receptions. He also recalled the “bloody ludicrous” hiring of Lindsay Anderson as director for the 1985 trip.
summary.zh: 威猛乐队成为首个在中国巡演的西方流行乐队四十年后，安德鲁·里奇利回顾了那次超现实的经历，包括沉默的演出和尴尬的使馆招待会。他还回忆起1985年那次旅行中“荒谬至极”地聘请林赛·安德森担任导演。

body.en: Four decades after he and George Michael became the first western pop act to tour the country, Ridgeley recalls silent gigs, awkward embassy receptions – and the ‘bloody ludicrous’ hiring of Lindsay Anderson as director Wham! special – read about George Michael’s great lost superstar duets album There has always been something surreal about Wham!’s 1985 trip to China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley looked like alien visitors on the streets of Beijing, their bouffant hair and flamboyant outfits setting them apart from the Mao jackets and drab uniforms of the Chinese people they encountered. Now the full strangeness of the duo’s brief trip, which made them the first western pop act to play in the country, is explored in a fascinating documentary film, Wham! 10 Days in China. Using previously unseen archive footage and featuring new interviews with many of the people involved in the tour, it shows the extraordinary impact Wham!’s two concerts had on their Chinese audience, as well as providing a snapshot of a country on the brink of great change. Continue reading...
body.zh: 里奇利和乔治·迈克尔成为第一个在中国巡演的西方流行艺人四十年后，里奇利回忆起无声的演出、尴尬的大使馆招待会，以及聘请林赛·安德森担任导演的“极其荒唐”的事。威猛乐队 1985 年的中国之行总是给人一种超现实的感觉。乔治·迈克尔（George Michael）和安德鲁·里奇利（Andrew Ridgeley）在北京街头看起来就像外来的访客，他们蓬松的头发和华丽的服装使他们与他们遇到的中国人的毛泽东夹克和土褐色制服截然不同。现在，一部引人入胜的纪录片《威猛！》（Wham！中国10天。它使用了以前未公开的档案片段，并对参与巡演的许多人进行了新的采访，展示了威猛乐队的两场音乐会对中国观众的非凡影响，并提供了一个处于巨大变革边缘的国家的快照。继续阅读...

This reminds us that every step into the unknown, whether personal or...
reflection.zh: 威猛乐队对中国的开创性巡演是一次进入未知文化领域的尝试，充满了新奇和意想不到的挑战。当我们把自己的计划和努力交托给雅伟时，我们承认即使是最雄心勃勃或不寻常的项目也能找到其目的和方向。这提醒我们，无论是个人还是文化上，每一步迈向未知都可以信赖更高的智慧。

title.en: Watch: Scaffolding tumbles from Hong Kong building as Typhoon Noul makes landfall
title.zh: 观看：台风“诺尔”登陆香港，脚手架从大楼坠落

summary.en: Typhoon Noul, described by state media as the strongest to hit China this year, caused scaffolding to collapse from a building in Hong Kong as it made landfall.
summary.zh: 据官方媒体报道，台风“诺尔”是今年迄今为止登陆中国的最强台风，在香港登陆时导致一栋建筑的脚手架倒塌。

body.en:
Police said they received numerous calls after multi-storey scaffolding along Cheung Sha Wan Road collapsed in powerful winds on Saturday. No injuries have been reported.

Typhoon Noul made landfall in southern China on Sunday morning, lashing the region with strong winds and heavy rain and forcing Hong Kong airport to cancel around 360 passenger flights.

The typhoon is the strongest to make landfall in China in 2026 to date, according to state media.
body.zh: 警方表示，周六长沙湾道多层脚手架在强风中倒塌后，他们接到大量报警电话。目前还没有人员受伤的报告。 台风诺尔周日早上在中国南部登陆，给该地区带来强风和大雨，迫使香港机场取消约360个客运航班。 据官方媒体报道，这场台风是迄今为止在 2026 年登陆中国的最强台风。

reflection.en: The destructive power of a typhoon reminds us of creation's vulnerability and the forces that cause it to groan. In such moments, we are reminded of the wider suffering in the world, and our longing for restoration.
reflection.zh: 台风的破坏力提醒我们，受造界是脆弱的，并且有使其呻吟的力量。在这样的时刻，我们被提醒世上更广泛的苦难，以及我们对复兴的渴望。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Berlin Pride: Latest in string of deadly vehicle attacks
title.zh: 柏林骄傲游行：最新一起致命车辆袭击事件

summary.en: A vehicle attack at a Berlin Pride event is the latest in a series of incidents where vehicles have been used as weapons, with similar attacks reported in the US, Canada, and China in recent years.
summary.zh: 柏林骄傲游行活动中发生的一起车辆袭击事件，是近年来车辆被用作武器的系列事件中最新的一起，美国、加拿大和中国也曾发生过类似的袭击。

body.en:
The attack at a Berlin Pride event is only the most recent incident on a long list where vehicles were used as weapons. The US, Canada, and China also saw similar attacks in recent years.

A Christopher Street Day event in the German capital, which attracts thousands of people every year, was attacked on Saturday night by a 21-year-old suspect who police said was associated with the "Islamist scene" in Berlin. One person was killed and another 16 people were injured, while the suspect, named as Abdul B., fled the scene.

Two people were killed and 20 more injured in early May when a car drove through a crowd in the eastern German city of Leipzig. The suspect in the case was described as a 33-year-old German national and local resident, who had been known to police, though not for relevant offenses.

At least two people were killed and several were injured in the southwestern German city of Mannheim in 2025 when a motorist intentionally drove his car into a crowd of people , according to police and public prosecutors. Authorities identified the suspect as a 40-year-old German man. Law enforcement ruled out a political motive at the time, though the man had paid a fine under Germany's hate crime laws for a comment he made on a social media platform in 2018.

A 37-year-old woman and her two-year-old daughter were killed in Munich in February last year when a car was rammed into a demonstration organized by the trade union Verdi. A 25-year-old Afghan man subsequently went on trial for their murder, as well as the attempted murder of the dozens of other people injured in the attack. 

A vehicle plowed into a crowd of New Orleans revelers early on New Year's Day 2025, killing 14 people and injuring dozens of others. The driver of the vehicle and two police officers were killed in a firefight soon after the attack, which took place at about 3:15 in the morning local time. The FBI said it was investigating the incident as an act of terrorism.

At least six people died and more than 300 were injured when a man slammed a rented BMW SUV into a Christmas market in eastern Germany. The suspect, who was arrested at the scene, was a 50-year-old doctor originally from Saudi Arabia who had expressed anti-Muslim views and support for the far-right AfD party. In June 2026, he was sentenced to life in prison, with the court noting the severity of his crime, which more or less rules out the possibility of an early release.

body.zh: 柏林骄傲活动中的袭击只是一长串将车辆用作武器的事件中的最新一起。近年来，美国、加拿大和中国也发生过类似的攻击。 德国首都的克里斯托弗街日活动每年都会吸引数千人参加，周六晚上，该活动遭到一名 21 岁嫌疑人的袭击，警方称该嫌疑人与柏林的“伊斯兰主义现场”有关。造成 1 人死亡、16 人受伤，嫌疑人 Abdul B. 逃离现场。 5 月初，德国东部城市莱比锡一辆汽车驶过人群，造成两人死亡、二十多人受伤。据描述，该案嫌疑人是一名 33 岁的德国国民和当地居民，警方认识他，但并未因相关罪行而认识他。 据警方和检察官称，2025 年，德国西南部城市曼海姆一名驾车者故意驾车冲撞人群，造成至少两人死亡、多人受伤。 当局确认嫌疑人是一名 40 岁的德国男子。执法部门当时排除了政治动机，尽管该男子因 2018 年在社交媒体平台上发表的评论而根据德国仇恨犯罪法缴纳了罚款。 去年2月，慕尼黑工会威尔第组织的一场示威活动中，一辆汽车被撞，导致一名37岁的妇女和她两岁的女儿丧生。一名 25 岁的阿富汗男子随后因谋杀以及企图谋杀袭击中受伤的其他数十人而接受审判。 2025 年元旦早些时候，一辆汽车冲撞了新奥尔良狂欢者的人群，造成 14 人死亡、数十人受伤。袭击发生在当地时间凌晨 3 点 15 分左右，车辆司机和两名警察在袭击发生后不久的交火中丧生。 联邦调查局表示，正在将此事件作为恐怖主义行为进行调查。 一名男子将一辆租来的宝马 SUV 撞向德国东部的圣诞市场，造成至少 6 人死亡、300 多人受伤。现场被捕的嫌疑人是一名来自沙特阿拉伯的 50 岁医生，曾表达反穆斯林观点并支持极右翼选择党。 2026 年 6 月，他被判处终身监禁，法院注意到他罪行的严重性，这或多或少排除了提前释放的可能性。 2024 年 11 月 11 日，一名 62 岁的司机驾驶一辆小型 SUV 撞向在中国南方一个体育场馆锻炼的人们，造成 38 人死亡，这是该国多年来最致命的大规模凶杀案。另有 48 人受伤。当局表示，肇事者情绪激动……

reflection.en: The repeated use of vehicles as weapons in public spaces highlights the destructive presence of evil in our world. In the face of such acts, Yahweh calls us not to be overcome by evil, but to actively overcome evil with good, fostering safety and compassion.
reflection.zh: 车辆在公共场所被反复用作武器，凸显了我们世界中破坏性邪恶的存在。面对此类行径，雅伟呼召我们不要被恶所胜，而是要积极地以善胜恶，培养安全与怜悯。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

body.en: The collapse of the rules-based order is not confined to the land: we’re imperilled as centuries of maritime cooperation sink beneath the waves The US military campaign to protect merchant shipping from Iranian attacks by asserting direct maritime control in the strait of Hormuz is not an idea unique to Donald Trump’s administration. Almost exactly 200 years ago, in the period 1825-27, a powerful US naval squadron led by Commodore John Rodgers was sent to the Mediterranean to defend American ships from the depredations of Greek corsairs and pirates. For all the new-minted republic’s brave talk of liberty, the US squadron did not assist Greece’s ongoing “regime change” struggle for independence from the Ottoman empire. Its sole, self-serving purpose was to defend US trade, markets and business interests. After abandoning his call for a people’s revolution in Tehran , this, too, is what Trump’s reckless war with Iran has now boiled down to. title.en: Vietnamese vessel sinks in South China Sea, 17 missing
title.zh: 越南船只在南海沉没，17人失踪

summary.en: A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members sank near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, one of the world's most important and contested maritime spaces.
summary.zh: 一艘载有62名船员的越南籍货船在南海永暑礁附近沉没，导致17人失踪。南海是世界上最重要且争议不断的海域之一。

body.en:
A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members sank near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, one of the world's most important and contested maritime spaces.

Rescuers were searching on Sunday for 17 people missing after a Vietnamese ship sank in the South China Sea , China's ⁠state media reported.

Authorities in the Chinese island province of Hainan said the cargo vessel Khoi ​Nguyen 18 ran into trouble near Yongshu Reef, also known as Fiery Cross Reef, state broadcaster CCTV said.

The ship was carrying 62 crew members, and 45 people were rescued from the water.

Vietnamese authorities arrived at the scene immediately after the cargo ship "sank while operating in bad weather conditions in the East Sea," Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Pham Thu Hang said in a statement to AFP news agency.

A Chinese rescue ship, the Nanhai Jiu 115, first spotted what was believed to be a distress flare from the vessel shortly before 6:30 pm on Saturday (1030 GMT).

The Khoi Nguyen 18 is a Vietnamese-registered ship measuring just under 70 meters (230 feet) in length, according to state news agency Xinhua.

It added that six Chinese vessels, a rescue helicopter and a Vietnamese vessel were involved in the search-and-rescue operations.

Hang said that authorities and fishing vessels were "actively searching for the remaining people."

Beijing claims sovereignty over almost the entire South China Sea, despite the 2016 international ruling, initiated by the Philippines against China, that its assertion has no legal basis.

One of the most highly contested areas is the ​ Spratly Islands , which China calls the Nansha Islands, where China has built runways ⁠and militarized artificial islands.

But ​Beijing's sweeping claims to the busy waterway overlap with those of other countries, including Vietnam, the Philippines, Brunei, Malaysia and Taiwan .

title.en: US-China AI rivalry heats up as Chinese models gain ground
title.zh: 中美人工智能竞争加剧，中国模型迎头赶上

summary.en: China's AI platforms are rapidly advancing, narrowing the gap with US technology. This progress has led to renewed threats from the Trump administration, alongside accusations of intellectual property theft, raising concerns about escalating tensions between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正迅速缩小与美国同行的差距。这一进展引发了特朗普政府新的威胁，并伴随着知识产权盗窃的指控，令人担忧两国之间的紧张关系可能升级。

body.en:
China's AI platforms are rapidly closing the gap with their US counterparts, prompting fresh threats from the Trump administration. With accusations of intellectual property theft, could tensions boil over?

In what seems like the blink of an eye,  China has gone from being up to five years behind the United States in top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) to lagging by just a few months.

While US players, including Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT , have spent hundreds of billions of dollars to push the frontier of AI, China has pursued a very different path .

Faced with US curbs on high-end chips that help AI to do its most advanced thinking, Chinese tech firms have prioritized dozens of open-source AI models built on "good enough"  technology .

These platforms, including DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and Xiaomi's MiMo, are now widely deployed across Chinese businesses, government services and consumer devices.

In the latest sign of the gap closing, Chinese startup Moonshot AI last week unveiled Kimi K3, a model that rivals one of the most advanced AI models — Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 — on key benchmarks.

In some tests, Kimi K3 matches or even surpasses Claude with far less computing power and at a fraction of the cost. 

Global technology specialist Alvin W. Graylin thinks Kimi K3's arrival turns high-end AI from an expensive luxury into something practical and affordable.

"For 98% of customers, the 1 to 2% difference [in knowledge] isn't worth paying 10 to 20 times more."

China's latest advance has already drawn a strong reaction from Washington, with US President Donald Trump now threatening to block US access to Chinese AI models.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, meanwhile, warned earlier this week that the US could sanction Chinese models over alleged intellectual property (IP) theft.

Anthropic  and OpenAI have accused Chinese labs of using their models to train their own systems, a process known as distilling.

While distilling is a common practice by AI labs worldwide to a limited extent, the companies say their models have been bombarded with queries to harvest advanced reasoning. The White House warned in April that China was doing it on an "industrial scale."

Beijing has hit back, rejecting the accusations as baseless and calling US threats of sanctions and model bans "technological bullying" to contain China's rise.

Giulia Neaher, a research analyst at the Strategic Foresight Hub at the Washington-based Stimson Center think tank, downplayed the role of distilling in Kimi's progress.

title.en: 'Strong concerns': Australia meets with China following ballistic missile test
title.zh: “强烈关切”：澳大利亚在中国弹道导弹试验后与中方会晤

summary.en: Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, expressing "strong concerns" and reiterating the importance of transparency following a recent ballistic missile test.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤与中国外长举行会晤，对近期弹道导弹试验表达了“强烈关切”，并重申了透明度的重要性。

body.en:
Australia has raised its concerns with China over its nuclear-capable missile test in the South Pacific, noting many of the region's nations also shared the same view.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong met with her Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on the sidelines of ASEAN talks in the Philippines capital, Manila, on Tuesday evening.

"You speak about the importance of mutual understanding. I agree, and I expect we will discuss our concerns ... including around peace and stability in our region, safe and professional military conduct, and the importance of transparency and reassurance of intent," Wong said in opening remarks.

Wong noted the "strong concerns" expressed by many Pacific Island countries about the submarine-launched missile earlier in July.

The two foreign ministers also discussed the importance of peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific.

"You've often heard me say that we will cooperate where we can and disagree where we must, and we want to continue to engage because we believe that is in our national interest," Wong said.

Australia was only given a few hours' notice by China of the test, which was launched within hours of Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signing a new defence alliance with Fiji.

Albanese slammed the launch as a "provocative act" while other Pacific nations including New Zealand, Tuvalu and Fiji condemned the incident.

Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale was standing beside his Australian counterpart in his country's capital Honiara in early July when he said the test was "not the act of a friend".

Albanese has previously flagged a strong statement would be issued by the Pacific Islands Forum, but the group's disagreement on the wording of the text has resulted in a delay.

A foreign ministers' meeting of the forum will be held in August, where the issue is likely to be discussed.

body.en:
Almost one million Origin Energy customers had their details accessed by hackers after a major data breach last week, the company has revealed.

On Tuesday, Origin said it had completed an initial review into the incident and identified that approximately 900,000 current and former customers' data was accessed by the hackers.

"To our customers, I am sorry. We don't take for granted the trust customers place in Origin and our safeguarding of their information," CEO Frank Calabria said in a statement.

Last week, the energy company announced it was the victim of the security incident , saying names, addresses, dates of birth, phone numbers and account information could all have been viewed.

Other potential details include the last four digits of credit cards, or the last three digits of bank accounts.

The company said it would be contacting affected customers first and was opening up a dedicated hotline for those concerned.

Origin said it had been trying to confirm the credibility of the threat since early July.

"We worked to confirm its credibility and potential impact; however, based on the information available, it was not assessed to be credible," Calabria said.

"On 22 July, new information emerged that indicated a potential security incident may have occurred. We acted immediately, providing updates to the market and notifying our customers as a precaution."

Origin, which has 4.8 million customer accounts in Australia and provides electricity, natural gas, LPG and internet services, said last week it did not believe the data obtained included credit card or bank details.

The company has also warned customers to be alert to a greater risk of scams that could arise from the data breach, advising customers to be wary of unexpected calls, emails or texts referring to their account.

Those who get such contact should independently contact Origin through numbers on official channels, it said, and do not provide passwords or personal information to anyone.

"We are acutely aware that others may exploit this incident, including by impersonating Origin or through other scam activity," Calabria said.

"We recommend that all our customers remain vigilant to suspicious activity and a heightened risk of scams.

Griffith University's Graeme Hughes, an expert on business and consumer issues, said the breach was unlikely to cause cases of payment fraud but marked a "social engineering problem".

"The last four digits for a card, a date of birth, and an authentic billing history are the exact trust signals a business uses to verify itself over the phone," Hughes told the Australian Associated Press.

title.en: ACTU leaders Sally McManus and Michele O'Neil to step aside for 'new generation'
title.zh: ACTU 领导人莎莉·麦克马纳斯 (Sally McManus) 和米歇尔·奥尼尔 (Michele O'Neil) 为“新一代”让位

summary.en: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese thanked the pair for their "tireless advocacy" for workers.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Australia's most powerful union figures have stepped down after almost a decade, saying a new generation of leaders was needed amid ongoing turbulence in the movement.

Sally McManus has been secretary of the Australian Council of Trade Unions (ACTU) since 2017, and Michele O'Neil its president since 2018.

The pair announced on Monday that they would leave their posts, making way for younger leaders to "take (the) movement forward".

''The ACTU's union affiliates will decide on the next leadership team, initially with the ACTU Executive filling the casual vacancies and then through an election at next year's congress, which will coincide with the ACTU's 100th anniversary," the pair said in a statement.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

McManus will finish in the role at the end of August, while O'Neil will depart before the end of the year to ''assist with the leadership transition''.

While the pair have been praised for their work in securing deals for workers, the ACTU has been plagued by difficulties after alleged infiltration of criminals in the Construction, Forestry and Maritime Employees Union (CMFEU).

In 2024, McManus denied she knew of any of the behaviour in the Victorian branch, and also oversaw the ACTU's suspension of CFMEU divisions while it sorted itself out.

It was "essential" the sector emerged from that turbulent period under new leadership, O'Neil told ABC RN on Tuesday.

"Workers who work in the construction industry around this country, by and large, are hardworking, good people who work in tough and dangerous jobs, and they deserve a great union," she said.

"They deserve a union that is completely free of any violence or corruption or organised crime," she said.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese thanked the pair for their "tireless advocacy" for workers, and their support to him personally.

"It is fitting that Sally and Michele announce they're stepping down from their respective positions at a time when there have been significant wage increases in critical and long-undervalued sectors, the gender pay gap is at a record low and union membership is growing for the first time in decades", he said in a statement.

title.en: 'I'm not Jacinta Allan': Caroll pledges 'new direction' and calls a royal commission

New Victorian Premier Ben Carroll has declared he will lead his government in a "new direction", while distancing himself from his predecessors Jacinta Allan and Daniel Andrews.

In his first comments after being elected state Labor leader, Carroll also announced a royal commission into the construction sector, which has been marred by corruption allegations, and the strengthening of Victoria's anti-corruption watchdog.

"Let me make one thing very clear: I am not Daniel Andrews. I am not Jacinta Allan," he said on Tuesday afternoon, just hours after Allan's resignation.

The former deputy premier said "circumstances changed" in the six weeks since he promised Allan he would not challenge her for the top job. He thanked Allan for her service to the Labor Party and the state.

Carroll was elected to the top job after a chaotic party room meeting triggered by Allan's resignation, following her loss of party support amid dire polling.

Polls showed voters are frustrated with the high cost of living, rising state debt, infrastructure delays and alleged corruption on the state's Big Build projects.

Carroll was expected to secure the leadership unopposed before Victorian Attorney-General Sonya Kilkenny mounted a late challenge.

Under Labor rules, a contested leadership ballot must be put to a vote of the party's rank-and-file members.

The process could take weeks and would plunge the government into political instability just months before the November state election.

But after a lengthy meeting, during which both yelling and cheering could be heard at various stages, Carroll emerged as premier. State Transport Minister Gabrielle Williams was elected his deputy.

Announcing her resignation on Tuesday morning, Allan said it had been an honour to serve as leader.

"Thank you to the Victorian people. It has been the honour of my life to serve you as your premier. I stepped down after 1,036 days in this role. Not one of them wasted, not one of them easy."

Allan said she believed she would have won a rank-and-file membership vote, but said the process would have been damaging in the lead-up to the November election.

"More importantly, it puts the state in a position of uncertainty. That hurts the Victorian people, and I just won't do that. At the end of the day, I am, and always have been, a team player."

body.en:
Ben Carroll has been sworn in as Victoria's new premier, but it was far from a straightforward change in power.

After Jacinta Allan announced her resignation as premier this morning, she seemed to express her support for Carroll to emerge as her successor.

However, reports have since emerged that she backed another contender in the subsequent caucus vote to elect a new leader.

While levels of party-room support seemed to guarantee that Carroll would become the next leader, a surprise curveball was thrown when Planning Minister Sonya Kilkenny challenged him for leadership, throwing the caucus meeting into chaos.

During Tuesday morning's meeting, Carroll faced a surprise leadership challenge from Kilkenny, who earned the support of 15 MPs — including Allan herself — according to The Age newspaper.

Three sources in the room told the paper Carroll had secured the support of more than two-thirds of caucus.

After a lengthy meeting that featured both yelling and applause behind closed doors, caucus whip Juliana Addison emerged to declare Carroll had been "unanimously" elected.

"I am delighted to announce that Ben Carroll has been unanimously elected for the Parliamentary Labor Party as our next Premier of Victoria," she said.

In a separate vote for deputy premier, Gabrielle Williams — briefly installed as interim leader after Allan's resignation — defeated Steve Dimopoulos, one of Allan's key backers.

Carroll has now been sworn in as premier, just four months out from the November state election.

During her resignation speech less than an hour before Tuesday's meeting, Allan said she welcomed Carroll as the next leader, but maintained she believed she would have won a party vote.

"After speaking with my colleagues overnight, I have made the difficult decision to step aside as leader of the Victorian state parliamentary Labor Party, and as premier of Victoria," Allan said at a press conference on Tuesday ahead of the caucus meeting.

"Should Ben Carroll emerge as our next Labor leader and Labor premier, he will have my congratulations and unqualified support."

Allan — who had initially refused to step down — said she was resigning because it was the "right thing" to do, but maintained she "would have won" a vote.

Carroll, Victoria's deputy premier, had been primed for a leadership challenge against Allan after a cross-factional delegation, including six ministers, told the premier she had lost majority support of the caucus.

title.en: 'Self-defeating': The catch in Australia's new oil refinery plan
title.zh: “弄巧成拙”：澳大利亚新炼油厂计划的陷阱

summary.en: Australia could get its first new refinery in six decades, but an expert says it raises questions about oil production.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The federal government will spend $4 million on a study to investigate whether a new oil refinery should be built in Western Australia, which would be the country's first such new facility in six decades.

The plan is aimed at buffering the nation to global oil shocks as the United States-Israeli war on Iran continues to impact supply and fuel costs.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is due to visit Karratha on Tuesday to announce the jointly funded pre-feasibility study for the potential refinery, which would be Australia's first newly built facility since the 1960s.

The project has been proposed by fertiliser producer Perdaman, which currently has a $6.4 billion fertiliser manufacturing facility being built in Karratha.

If the refinery goes ahead, it would be the nation's third, along with facilities in Brisbane and Geelong. Those two facilities supply roughly 10 to 20 per cent of the country's fuel.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Australia relies heavily on imported refined fuels. Almost 90 per cent of Australia's daily fuel consumption is imported, much of it brought in as refined product from South Korea, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia and Taiwan.

The country used to have more domestic oil refineries, but six of eight facilities closed between 2003 and 2021, after newer, more economical mega-refineries were built across Asia in the 1990s.

Earlier this year, a fire at the Geelong facility , which supplies 10 per cent of the nation's fuel, sparked fears of a fuel supply shortage as Australia was reeling from global oil shocks triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran.

That incident highlighted Australia's vulnerability to shocks in both international and domestic supply chains.

However, a new refinery would only partly shield Australia from international oil-supply shocks, as it would still be reliant on imported crude oil.

Nonetheless, Resources Minister Madeleine King has said that it would still improve Australia's resilience in times of crisis because crude oil can be stored for far longer than refined oil products.

"So you can bring it in and have it sit in a vessel for some amount of time before you need to refine it. And that's a critical difference in times of crisis," she told ABC Radio National.

"This (would) make a great difference ... to sovereign capacity — being able to have capacity on the west coast to refine crude oil into this product."

There is potential for new oil discovery off the Western Australian coast, although it has not yet come to fruition.

body.en:
Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan faces an open leadership challenge, with Deputy Premier Ben Carroll officially vying for the top role.

"It is clear that the Premier has lost the majority of our Caucus," Carroll said in a statement on Monday as he made his intentions for nomination known.

If she falls, her successor will inherit difficult political circumstances just four months out from Labor's most challenging state election in over a decade.

The party's polling has collapsed as it campaigns for a fourth consecutive term against the rising popularity of One Nation. Polling suggests voters are frustrated with the high cost of living, rising state debt, and infrastructure delays.
